notes.title: We've updated the update with some voice actor changes!
notes.content:
The following changes were made to the update on March 23rd.
- Change of voice actor (Orino Koi)
- Changes to high-speed mode specifications
- Other minor corrections

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005167/6ca8f52c537ab3c2838a89e50e67e7bb86f8d12c.png[/img]

▢CV Change
As for the voice actor for Orino Koi, due to the change in environment, it has become difficult to record properly, so we will change the voice actor in consideration of new recordings for the complete version, just in case!

Of course, the "roles without additional recordings" will remain the same.

▢About the release of high-speed mode
Until the true ending was achieved, high-speed mode was unlocked, but it will be unlocked after "Koibana" in March 2026!

If you find any bugs, glitches, or anything else, please report them via DM from X or Romankessha@gmail.com!
